open_issues.impact: hard risk 'offline mode reports success while pending remains' is mitigated, not closed, for not-due markers without a drain request
open_issues.next: docs pass (D43): state the recovery order in the hub guide. Optional backend follow-up (P5.5 domain, needs a D#): a lease flag that ignores triggers, or a pending count in the lease answer
open_issues.text: An empty lease answer does not prove that no pending marker is left. The backend (P5.5) leases a generation only when it has a drain request or reached a trigger (500 updates / 1 MiB / 10 min), and skips generations under another hub's unexpired lease. compact --pending exit 0 therefore means 'nothing leasable is left'. Unspent leases of its own run are waited out, so a failed or conflicted document is never hidden. The sound offline recovery order is: vaulter:collaboration:drain (it requests a drain for every marker and keeps the requests when the hub is down), then compact --pending, then vaulter:collaboration:drain again to confirm from the markers. With the module raw-disabled (config=false) the hub endpoints answer 404, so compact --pending cannot help there.

open_issues.text: Detail choices (D44, detail level). (a) Env names follow the VAULTER_COLLAB_ prefix used by P5.7 (VAULTER_COLLAB_MODE for COLLAB_MODE): VAULTER_COLLAB_COMPACTION_INTERVAL_MS (default 2000, so a drain is answered well inside drain.restore_deadline 10 s) and VAULTER_COLLAB_COMPACTION_BATCH (default 10, 1..100). (b) compact --pending exits 2 for a usage or configuration error (missing --pending, a bad --deadline, a missing VAULTER_COLLAB_WEBHOOK_SECRET or backend URL) before it calls the backend. The item rule's exits 0 and 1 apply once compaction runs. A lease call the backend refuses (e.g. 401) is asked again until the deadline, then exit 1. (c) A checkpoint attempt gets max(retry attempt timeout, VAULTER_COLLAB_WEBHOOK_TIMEOUT_MS), because a checkpoint can carry max_state_bytes. The series keeps full jitter and ≤5 attempts and is capped by the lease (expiry minus a 2 s margin, measured against the answer's Date header). (d) hub_id = '<instanceName>@<hostname>#<pid>', at most 191 bytes.

open_issues.impact: a projection may briefly trail the binary state in a multi-hub race; no data loss if the assumption holds
open_issues.next: reviewer: confirm against yjs 13.6 encodeStateAsUpdateV2 (pendingStructs/pendingDs merge)
open_issues.text: Assumption about yjs 13.6: when the tail holds an update whose causal predecessor is not yet in the log (seq order differs from causal order across two hubs), Yjs keeps it as pending structs, and Y.encodeStateAsUpdate includes pending structs. The checkpoint therefore loses nothing, but the projection lacks that update until the missing one is checkpointed.

summary: Hub compaction for D26 rev.3 p.1. (1) src/compaction.js: compactLease(entry) merges a lease entry on a new Y.Doc: the checkpoint C, then the tail (C,H] in seq order through persistence.js replayLog, the same replay a room load uses. It checks the tail is exactly C+1..H and returns state = Y.encodeStateAsUpdate (base64), content = the TipTap JSON projection, coveredFrom C, coveredThrough H and expectedCheckpointVersion. It refuses (CompactionError: invalid_lease, incomplete_tail, empty_log, invalid_update, unknown_type, projection_loss) anything that cannot become a faithful checkpoint. Projection loss reads the projection back through the hub schema and applies schema.js lostAttributes, the same check as buildSeed; an unknown node or mark also counts as a loss. (2) src/worker.js: createWorker() makes one lease call per pass (hub_id, max = VAULTER_COLLAB_COMPACTION_BATCH), then compacts and publishes each entry in the backend's order (drain requests first). A full batch is leased again at once; otherwise the next pass waits VAULTER_COLLAB_COMPACTION_INTERVAL_MS (default 2000). A checkpoint is published only while the lease holds, with a 2 s margin, measured against the answer's Date header so clock skew does not stretch it. Any 409 (checkpoint conflict, epoch mismatch) is dropped and never retried. Network errors, 5xx and 429 are retried with retry.js, capped by the lease. A failed compaction is logged and counted (failures, projectionLosses) and nothing is published. drain({deadlineMs}) repeats passes until an empty lease answer, accepted only once every unspent lease of the run has expired; otherwise it stops at the deadline with the remaining documents. stats(), start(), stop() and events (outcome, compacted, protocolMismatch) are exposed. (3) src/backend.js: leaseCompaction() and publishCheckpoint() (signed, no room token, protocol 2) and the CHECKPOINT_CONFLICT code. (4) src/cli.js (#!/usr/bin/env node, mode +x, package bin vaulter-collaboration-hub): 'serve' boots index.js; 'compact --pending [--deadline=<s>]' (default 60 s) runs without a WebSocket server. Exit 0 = nothing leasable is left, exit 1 = deadline passed with the pending document ids (generation, last outcome) on stderr, exit 2 = usage or config error before any backend call. (5) src/index.js exports boot() and starts the worker after listen (server.vaulterWorker); a protocol mismatch from the worker is reported to the persistence. (6) src/config.js: VAULTER_COLLAB_COMPACTION_INTERVAL_MS (min 10) and VAULTER_COLLAB_COMPACTION_BATCH (1..100). The numeric checks moved to one table, and validateCompactConfig() is new: backend URL in production, webhook secret required, no origins or ports. (7) package.json: bin, start/dev through cli serve, check covers cli/compaction/worker. Dockerfile: ENTRYPOINT [node, src/cli.js], CMD [serve]. (8) Tests: compaction.test.js (3 client updates from separate Y.Docs plus a checkpoint equal to Y.mergeUpdates; seed-first log; republish when H = C; every refusal), worker.test.js (lease without an open room → one checkpoint covering (4,5], HMAC and protocol headers, no Authorization; 409 conflict or epoch not retried; 5xx retried with the same publication; exhausted series; expired lease not published; projection loss logged and counted; order and full batch; lease failure logged once; protocol mismatch event; drain() semantics; config keys), compact-cli.test.js (child process against a loopback mock: exit 0 after an empty second lease, exit 1 with document 77 on stderr after about 2 s, exit 1 naming a 401 lease failure, exit 2 for usage/config errors with no backend call, parseArguments, bin, shebang, Dockerfile ENTRYPOINT/CMD). (9) tests/baseline: scripts/t baseline --write -p hub (hub 19 → 22 files). Other commands, all exit 0: npm run check; node --test retry/ledger/webhook/v1-paths/config/security (79 pass); scripts/t baseline --compare -p core,media,drive,webhooks,documents,collaboration,azgard,filament,repo,hub; throwaway control-flow checks of worker.js and cli.js under stubbed yjs/transformer/tiptap/dotenv in $TMPDIR (10 pass, not committed).
